verdict: Cloud DP content distribution fails with a hash mismatch on `Contentinfo.tar`. The BranchCache publication key is different across primary sites in the hierarchy, so each site produces a different hash for the same file.
fix: Synchronize the BranchCache key across all primary sites. On the CAS: `SELECT Value1 FROM SC_Properties WHERE Name = 'BranchCacheKey'`. On each primary site, run: `netsh branchcache set key passphrase='<cas-value>'`. Redistribute affected packages. This only applies when multiple primary sites publish to the same cloud DP.
